verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment service, so getting past anti-bot, CAPTCHA, and login walls is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions CAPTCHA solving, authenticated sessions, login handling, or form submission. The closest items are claims about extracting data from "complicated websites" and about AI agents that read pages like a person to survive redesigns; neither addresses anti-bot or auth walls.
